meta.description: Reviewed latitude/longitude for the bus stops the site lists. 12 stops were added and 3 were upgraded by hand after scripts/geocode_stops.py ran (see manualAdditions below); the unresolved/rejectedByRouteGeometry counts below still describe that automated pass only, not the manual additions.
meta.licence: Stop coordinates are copied from openly published datasets: arkodeepg/calcutta-transport and murmusuvash2-wq/busjatri-open-data (ODbL 1.0 (c) OpenStreetMap contributors; GeoNames CC BY 4.0; Wikidata CC0). Entries fetched with --osm are (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0.
rules: A coordinate is copied from a source, never interpolated or averaged.
A match found through an abbreviation or a dropped noise word is capped at 'medium'.
A gazetteer or fuzzy match is 'review': check it in stop_coordinates_review.csv.
Coordinates outside 21.0-27.5 N / 86.0-90.0 E are dropped as name collisions.
A coordinate the route chains contradict is rejected: a bus cannot be 60 km from its previous stop.
An unresolved stop is absent, not estimated. The ride screen says so.

manualAdditions.description: Entries added by hand on top of scripts/geocode_stops.py's output, to work through next step/MISSING_COORDINATES.csv. Each was looked up against a real published map source (OpenStreetMap-derived listings, GeoNames, Wikipedia/Wikidata, or a specific business address) and sanity-checked against the before/after stops on its busiest route. Sources and notes are on each entry; see data/stop_coordinates_review.csv for the audit trail.

B.T. College.note: Wikimapia-labelled bus stand on route 223, between Madhyamgram Chowmatha and Birati. Community-sourced map, flagged for a second check.

Bakultala.note: Bakultala, Andul Road, Howrah (the stop used by routes 61/RT-20 between Chunavati and Danesh Shaikh Lane) -- NOT the same-named Bakultala stops in Behala/Kasba. Cross-checked against a second Andul Road address at 22.5651,88.2838 (~300m away).

Bonhooghly.note: Locality centroid (pincode 700108), not a bus-stop node; corroborated by a Wikimedia Commons geotagged photo of the area at 22.6463,88.3834 (~450m away).

Calcutta Leather Complex (Covers All 3 G.matchedOn: calcutta leather complex covers all 3 gates

Chandni Market.note: Chandni Chowk Market, Esplanade; cross-checked against Justdial listing at 22.5638,88.3540 (~250m away, same market).

Dhulagarh.note: 'Dhulagarh More' crossing; sits on the road between Ranihati and Alampur. Single source only, flagged for a second check.

Garia 6 No..note: Confirmed against four independent sources (latlong.net, mapcarta/OSM, Wikimapia, maps.me) all within 20m of the coordinate already on file.

Garia Depot.note: CSTC bus depot office, S C Mullick Road, Garia. Distinct from the 'Garia 6 No.' passenger terminus already in this file; flagged for human confirmation that this is the depot the site means.

Kadamtala.note: Kadamtala, Bantra, Howrah (between Howrah Maidan and Dasnagar) -- NOT the same-named Kadamtala in Behala or Jalpaiguri. The dataset's own automated match for this name was rejected for being 70km off-corridor, confirming the name collision.

Khanna Cinema.note: OSM-derived 'Khanna Cinema' bus stop, Hati Bagan / APC Road.

Moulali.note: OSM-derived 'Moulali' bus stop node (AJC Bose Rd / Moulali crossing); corroborated by rome2rio transit data at 22.5616,88.3666-88.3671.

Parnasree.note: Confirmed against GeoNames, which publishes the identical coordinate (22.50648,88.30154), and Wikipedia/Wikidata (22.509,88.306, ~300m away).

R.G. Kar Hospital.matchedName: R.G. Kar Medical College and Hospital
R.G. Kar Hospital.matchedOn: r g kar medical college and hospital

Rajballavpara.note: OSM-derived 'Raj Ballabh Para' bus stop, immediately south of the Shyambazar five-point crossing.

Rathtala.source: https://www.justdial.com (Belgharia Service Station, 'Near Kamarhati Municipality', Rathtala, B.T. Road)
Rathtala.note: Proxy location: a business address at Rathtala Mor, not the bus stop node itself. The dataset's own automated match for this name was rejected for being 15.5km off-corridor, so a name collision is known to exist; treat this as a rough placement pending a sharper source.

SDF Building.note: Confirmed against magicbricks.com (22.568879,88.431604) and an Airtel store listing (22.5687801,88.4317201), both within ~100m of the gazetteer coordinate already on file.

Shilpara.note: Bus stop POI on Diamond Harbour Road at Silpara; sits exactly between Sakherbazar and Thakurpukur on the route chain.
